segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I have Northstar at 42 seats today, contract runs through May 31, and you were looking at adding the support team before the June 17 go-live. Is that still the plan?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. We need 18 more seats, so 60 total. Support wants access for training by June 3, not the 17th, if we can make that work.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, that works. For 60 seats on the annual plan, you're at $54 per seat per month, billed annually. That puts the renewal plus expansion at $38,880 before tax. Same payment terms as last year, net 30.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Our finance team will ask if the invoice can show one line for the 42 renewing seats and one line for the 18 new seats, just for cost center tracking.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, easy enough. The order form will show both lines, and billing can mirror that on the invoice. No change to the subscription dates, so everything co-terms to May 31 next year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. We also need the admin training included. Last time it was two one-hour sessions, and that was enough.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. I'll include two remote admin training sessions, to be completed by June 14. Those are included at no charge with the 60-seat annual package.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send the order form to me and copy Marcus in procurement. If it matches what we just covered, I can route it for signature tomorrow.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. You'll have it this afternoon: 60 seats, $38,880 annual, net 30, co-termed through May 31, invoice split into two seat lines, and two admin trainings by June 14.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Thanks. Once it's signed, can we get the kickoff invite on the calendar for May 28?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. I'll hold May 28 at 10 a.m. Central with your admin group and our onboarding lead, and we'll confirm it once the order is back.
